files.role: Root component with global state management, screen routing, keyboard shortcuts, parallax background
files.quality: Moderate. Mixes concerns: routing, keyboard shortcuts, TTS orchestration, parallax, and settings persistence all in one component. Hardcoded key constants (ESCAPE_KEY, ENTER_KEY, SPACE_KEY) are fine for read-only constants.
issues: TTS speak() call is fire-and-forget with catch(() => {}) — swallowed errors
jarvis_mode saved via separate GetSettings+SaveSettings pattern (repeated 3x: here, ChatView, VoiceBar)
No error boundary or loading skeleton beyond simple text
setScreen('chat') as fallback in 2 places — inconsistent with loading state
improvements: Extract settings persistence into a useSettings hook to remove duplication
Add error boundary for the entire app
Centralize keyboard shortcut handling into a custom hook

files.role: Main chat view: message rendering, event subscriptions, input handling, send/retry logic
files.quality: Good. Well-structured with clear separation of concerns. Uses forwardRef correctly.
issues: counter is module-level mutable — not ideal for SSR but acceptable here
onAvatarEvent callback is a no-op stub — wasted subscription
renderPart is recreated on every render (could be useCallback)
improvements: Remove unused onAvatarEvent subscription (AvatarSystem handles it internally)
Memoize renderPart or inline the switch
Consider extracting chat input into its own component

files.role: State machine: transforms IncomingEvents into message array mutations
files.quality: Clean. Immutable updates, well-typed discriminated union. Good use of withoutStatus helper.
issues: status types use Set lookup in hot path — fine for small sets
avatar event dispatch uses window.dispatchEvent which bypasses the onAvatarEvent callback
updateAssistant function is pure but could be split into per-type handlers for readability
improvements: Split into per-event-type handler functions for easier testing
Consider using a reducer pattern with actions instead of switch/if chains

files.role: Wails runtime bridge to Go backend
files.quality: Good. Type-safe Go app interface definition with declare global.
issues: window.go.main.App is accessed directly everywhere — no error handling layer
void keyword suppresses errors silently
improvements: Add a small error wrapper function for Go calls
Consider creating a typed API client object

files.quality: Functional but fragile. Regex-based parsing is hacky.
issues: PCT_RE regex is brittle — depends on backend output format
No error handling if output doesn't match regex
The raw output fallback is not styled like other cards
improvements: Make regex more robust or switch to structured backend output
Add error boundary for malformed metric output
Style the fallback <pre> consistently with card design

files.quality: Functional. parseColumns is a standalone pure function.
issues: parseColumns uses double-space split which is fragile for variable-width columns
No min/max column validation in parsed rows
improvements: Consider using a tabular data library or structured backend output
Add input validation for parsed table data

files.role: Settings modal: System, AI Provider, Agents, Workers tabs
files.quality: Large component (386 lines) with multiple responsibilities.
issues: 386 lines — too large, violates single responsibility
DEFAULT_WORKERS hardcoded with emoji mapping in JSX (lines 363-367)
No dark mode theme variables — only light theme CSS exists
set() helper uses bracket notation with dynamic keys — error-prone
No loading state for settings fetch
alert() used for error handling instead of proper UI
improvements: Split into separate components: SystemTab, ProviderTab, AgentsTab, WorkersTab
Move DEFAULT_WORKERS and SHAPE_OPTIONS to a constants file
Replace alert() with toast/notification system
Extract emoji-to-shape mapping into a dedicated helper
Add dark mode CSS variables

files.role: R3F Canvas with orbit particles and core sphere
issues: CoreSphere uses hardcoded meshBasicMaterial color #5b9bd5 — should use theme/orb state colors
OrbitParticles shader uniforms are never updated with state (uColorMix, uAmplitude only set in useFrame for uTime)
No state-driven visual changes — particles don't react to thinking/listening/speaking
Lighting is hardcoded
Camera position hardcoded
improvements: Pass orb state to shader uniforms (uColorMix, uAmplitude, rotationSpeed)
Use ORB_COLORS from orbState for core sphere color
Animate particle speed/color based on state transitions
Add state transition animations (e.g., expand on speaking)

files.quality: Good shader code with proper additive blending and point sprites.
issues: Shader uniforms (uColorMix, uAmplitude) defined but never set from React state
Hardcoded color values in createOrbitMaterial — should accept params
No fragment shader response to state changes
improvements: Make createOrbitMaterial accept color params so state changes update the shader
Add uAmplitude to fragment shader for glow intensity
Add state transition uniforms (target colors for lerp)

files.role: Individual worker avatar with SVG icons, pulse/speak animations
files.quality: Well-structured with memo() for performance. Good SVG shape system.
issues: SVG_SHAPES and DEFAULT_SVG are module-level React elements — should use useMemo or just inline
resolveSvg creates new React elements on every render (memo should help but it's wasteful)
No size props — assumes fixed 36px avatar circles
improvements: Memoize SVG_SHAPES lookup or render SVG inline
Add size variants (sm/md/lg)
Add loading/error states for avatar images

files.role: Voice input UI: mic button, audio wave, jarvis toggle, listening hint
files.quality: Clean and focused. Good state management.
issues: MicRecorder uses deprecated ScriptProcessorNode — should use AudioWorkletProcessor
No debounce on input — rapid key presses could send duplicate messages
Emojis for state icons (🟡🔴🎤) may not render consistently across OS
improvements: Replace ScriptProcessorNode with AudioWorkletProcessor (deprecated API)
Add debouncing for transcript events
Use icon components instead of emojis for consistency

files.quality: Good implementation with proper cleanup and localStorage sync.
issues: Theme hook exists but is NOT used anywhere in the app — dead code
No dark mode CSS variables defined in style.css
data-theme attribute is set but CSS has no [data-theme='dark'] selectors
improvements: Define dark mode CSS variables in :root[data-theme='dark']
Actually use useTheme() in App.tsx to activate it
Add dark mode toggle to SettingsView Workers tab or System tab

files.role: Global amplitude singleton + Avatar list renderer
files.quality: Functional but has a problematic global mutable state pattern.
issues: globalAmplitude is a module-level mutable variable with direct mutation — not React-friendly
registerAmplitudeListener returns cleanup but globalAmplitudeListeners set is never cleared on unmount
setGlobalAmplitude is exported as a side-effectful function — hard to test
improvements: Replace with a proper React context or useStore pattern
Ensure all listeners are cleaned up on unmount
Add a dispose/cleanup function for the global state

duplicate_rules.details: .avatar, .avatar-circle, .avatar-icon, .avatar-label, .avatar-name, .avatar-task, .avatar-pulse-ring, .avatar-speak-ring, @keyframes fadeIn, @keyframes pulseRing, @keyframes speakPulse, @keyframes speakRing, .avatar.working, .avatar.speaking are all defined multiple times
.card has box-shadow and padding redefined, causing cascading overrides

unused_styles.details: #logo, .result, .input-box, .btn, .input are all Vite template remnants not used in the actual app
useTheme.ts sets data-theme attribute but style.css has no dark mode rules

hardcoded_values: #f1f5f9 (background in .card-pre, .card-table th, .pairing-box, progress bar — should use var(--bg-primary))
#e2e8f0 (slider background in .slider — should use CSS variable)
#5b9bd5, #6bc99a, #f6ad55 (hardcoded in orbMaterial.ts and AiOrb.tsx — should reference design tokens)
#f8f9fa (modal overlay background — same as --bg-primary but hardcoded)
#10b981 (point light color in AiOrb.tsx — not a design token)
#2d3748 (used in --text-main but also hardcoded in a few places)

spacing.assessment: Mostly consistent using rem units. Padding uses 1.15rem, 0.85rem, 1.75rem patterns. Could benefit from a spacing scale (4px/8px/12px/16px/24px).
issues: Inconsistent: some use 0.85rem, others 1rem, some use calc-based values
No CSS custom properties for font sizes — all hardcoded
Letter spacing varies: 0.01em to 0.08em without a scale

mobile_responsive.assessment: Not mobile-responsive. Designed as desktop app (fixed 100vh/100vw, no media queries except prefers-reduced-motion).
mobile_responsive.details: This is correct for a desktop app, not a bug. However, window.innerWidth/innerHeight references in App.tsx and ChatView could fail in small browser windows.

issues: No skip-to-content link
Chat log doesn't use aria-live='assertive' for new messages
Modal overlay doesn't trap focus

Shader.vertex: Orbit particle orbit with golden ratio phase offsets, amplitude-responsive Y offset
Shader.fragment: Point sprite with radial glow, 3-color mix (blue/green/orange), amplitude-based point size

what_exists.Animation: Particle rotation (0.15rad/s base), X-axis wobble (sin 0.3t * 0.1), time uniform updates

shader: uColorMix uniform is defined but NEVER set from React state in AiOrb.tsx
uAmplitude uniform is defined but never updated in the useFrame loop (only uTime is)
No rotationSpeed uniform — particles rotate at hardcoded 0.15*delta
No breathScale uniform — breathing animation not connected to shader
No distortion uniform — no visual deformation based on state
CoreSphere color is hardcoded #5b9bd5, never changes with state
No state transition animations (smooth color lerp between states)
visual: Particles don't expand/contract based on speaking amplitude
No visual distinction between thinking (fast spin) vs idle (slow spin) vs listening (gentle pulse)
Core sphere is a simple meshBasicMaterial — no shader-based pulsing
No glow/bloom effect for speaking state

good: Proper additive blending for glow effect
Point sprite with gl_PointCoord for soft circles
issues: createOrbitMaterial() called once at mount — no way to update colors
Uniforms not passed as parameters — hardcoding limits reusability
No material disposal tracking for state changes
orbMaterial_optimization.recommendation: Refactor to accept initial uniforms, then expose a ref-based update pattern so React can drive shader changes.

AiOrb_consumes_state_correctly.assessment: PARTIALLY. The Orb receives state as a prop but doesn't use it in the Canvas.
issues: state prop is typed and received but never passed to OrbitParticles or CoreSphere
useFrame only updates uTime, not uColorMix or uAmplitude on the orbit material
CoreSphere only uses amplitude for scale pulse, not for color changes
paused prop correctly controls frameloop

sections.title: Top 10 Improvement Opportunities (ranked by visual impact)

opportunities.title: Orb state-driven shader updates
opportunities.impact: HIGH — This is the visual centerpiece of the app. Currently the orb does NOT react to state changes (thinking/listening/speaking) despite having state computation in orbState.ts.
opportunities.description: Connect OrbState to shader uniforms so particles change color, speed, and distortion based on current state. Add smooth transitions between states. Make the core sphere pulse with speaking amplitude using a proper shader.

opportunities.title: Dark mode implementation
opportunities.impact: HIGH — useTheme.ts is fully implemented but completely unused. Adding dark mode CSS variables would dramatically change the app's feel.
opportunities.description: Add :root[data-theme='dark'] CSS variables for all design tokens. Wire useTheme() into App.tsx. Add a dark mode toggle to SettingsView system tab.

opportunities.title: CSS design system tokenization
opportunities.impact: HIGH — Removes hardcoded colors, establishes consistent design tokens, makes dark mode easier.
opportunities.description: Extract all hardcoded color values into CSS custom properties. Create a spacing scale. Add typography scale variables. Replace #f1f5f9 with var(--bg-primary), etc.

opportunities.title: Remove CSS duplication
opportunities.impact: MEDIUM-HIGH — 1660 lines with significant duplication. Cleaning up will make CSS maintainable.
opportunities.description: Remove duplicate avatar styles (3x), duplicate .tab-content, duplicate .card padding. Consolidate all avatar styles into a single section. Remove App.css entirely (legacy Vite template).

opportunities.title: SettingsView component decomposition
opportunities.impact: MEDIUM-HIGH — 386 lines is too large. Splitting into tabs will improve maintainability and enable parallel agent work.
opportunities.description: Split into: SettingsView (orchestrator), SystemTab, ProviderTab, AgentsTab, WorkersTab. Move DEFAULT_WORKERS, SHAPE_OPTIONS, emoji mapping to constants. Extract set() helper pattern.

opportunities.title: Avatar system: replace global mutable state
opportunities.impact: MEDIUM — Global mutable variables (globalAmplitude) are not React-friendly and cause testing difficulty.
opportunities.description: Replace globalAmplitude with React Context or Zustand store. Ensure proper cleanup on unmount. Make amplitude updates traceable.
blocks: orb shader updates (needs amplitude from proper source)

opportunities.title: Voice: replace deprecated ScriptProcessorNode
opportunities.impact: MEDIUM — ScriptProcessorNode is deprecated and will be removed from browsers.
opportunities.description: Replace with AudioWorkletProcessor for modern audio processing. Create a worklet processor file and load it dynamically.

opportunities.title: SettingsView: replace alert() with proper error UI
opportunities.impact: MEDIUM — alert() is jarring and blocks the main thread. A toast system would be much better.
opportunities.description: Create a simple toast/notification component. Replace all alert() calls. Add toast CSS styles and animation.

opportunities.title: Chat cards: improve MetricCard parsing
opportunities.impact: MEDIUM — Current regex parsing is fragile and breaks if backend output format changes.
opportunities.description: Make the regex more robust or switch to a line-based parser. Add error handling for unexpected output. Style the fallback consistently.

opportunities.title: Accessibility improvements
opportunities.impact: MEDIUM — Better keyboard navigation, focus management, and ARIA attributes.
opportunities.description: Add focus trapping in settings modal. Add skip-to-content link. Improve aria-live on chat. Make modal dismissible with Escape (already partially done but could be improved).
